Sections: Baseline specification; case-specific departures are reported in the robustness materials
Merits and truth
Q is uniform on [0,1]; true liability T | Q is Bernoulli(Q).
Signals
10 private signal bins per party; party noise 0.2; court noise 0.2; two court findings.
Damages and wealth
Damages 1; initial wealth 10 per party. Monetary quantities are in units of damages.
Preferences
Risk neutral or symmetric CARA risk aversion with alpha = 2.
Costs
Filing / answering: 0.15 each; additional trial costs: 0.15 each; ordinary multiplier 1.
Private exit commitments
After filing and answering, each party commits whether to exit if bargaining fails.
Agreement and offers
Simultaneous agreement; offers only if both agree. Separate information sets; own commitment is remembered.
Offer actions
0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, 0.45, 0.55, 0.65, 0.75, 0.85, 0.95; overlapping offers settle at their midpoint.
Unsuccessful bargaining
Apply private exit commitments: abandonment, default, mutual-exit lottery, or trial. Refusal is not a terminal disposition.
Fee rules
American: own costs. British: loser pays at trial and the specified unilateral exits. Trial-only fee shifting is a separate cost-1 extension.
